_instructions: Add a position when you enter a trade in Zerodha.
Required fields per position: ticker (with .NS suffix), entry_price, shares, entry_date (YYYY-MM-DD), initial_stop.
Optional: exit_price -- fill this with your real broker fill AFTER you sell. Leave null while open.
When a stop hits, Telegram pings you. Sell at Zerodha. Then update exit_price here. Then leave it for one digest cycle so it shows in journal. Then delete the entry.
Always run position sizing before adding: max_shares = floor((account_size * 0.02) / (entry_price - initial_stop)).
